function.arguments: {"answer": "The treatment improves the response rate by 0.151, compared to control, after adjusting for severity through stratification.", "value": 0.151, "method": "The analysis began by removing rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure sentinels) and deduplicating on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq row per patient, as required by the data dictionary.
